info.title: Doctofam API
info.description: Public REST API for Doctofam. Authenticate with an API key created in the Doctofam dashboard: send the base64-encoded key secret with HTTP Basic auth. Each key carries per-resource scopes like `patients:read` or `appointments:write`.

get.description: Lists the appointments of your clinic. Requires the `appointments:read` scope.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated projection of fields to return

403.description: API key is missing the `appointments:read` scope

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api.doctofam.com/api/appointments?clinicId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&patientId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&startTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&endTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&fields=SOME_STRING_VALUE' \
  --header 'Authorization: Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'

http GET 'https://api.doctofam.com/api/appointments?clinicId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&patientId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&startTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&endTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&fields=SOME_STRING_VALUE' \
  Authorization:'Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.doctofam.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH" }

conn.request("GET", "/api/appointments?clinicId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&patientId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&startTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&endTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&fields=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, [
  CURLOPT_URL => "https://api.doctofam.com/api/appointments?clinicId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&patientId=SOME_STRING_VALUE&startTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&endTime=SOME_STRING_VALUE&fields=SOME_STRING_VALUE",
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => "",
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => "GET",
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
    "Authorization: Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH"
  ],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);
$err = curl_error($curl);

curl_close($curl);

if ($err) {
  echo "cURL Error #:" . $err;
} else {
  echo $response;
}

<?php

$request = new HttpRequest();
$request->setUrl('https://api.doctofam.com/api/appointments');
$request->setMethod(HTTP_METH_GET);

$request->setQueryData([
  'clinicId' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'patientId' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'startTime' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'endTime' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'fields' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE'
]);

$request->setHeaders([
  'Authorization' => 'Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'
]);

try {
  $response = $request->send();

  echo $response->getBody();
} catch (HttpException $ex) {
  echo $ex;
}

<?php

$client = new http\Client;
$request = new http\Client\Request;

$request->setRequestUrl('https://api.doctofam.com/api/appointments');
$request->setRequestMethod('GET');
$request->setQuery(new http\QueryString([
  'clinicId' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'patientId' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'startTime' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'endTime' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE',
  'fields' => 'SOME_STRING_VALUE'
]));

$request->setHeaders([
  'Authorization' => 'Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'
]);

$client->enqueue($request)->send();
$response = $client->getResponse();

echo $response->getBody();
